paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2019 - Internet of Things Meets Brain-Computer Interface A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Enabling Hu
title: Internet of Things Meets Brain-Computer Interface: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Enabling Human-Thing Cognitive Interactivity
venue: IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence
motivation: BCI控制IoT设备时脑信号低信噪比、特征工程耗时且依赖领域专家
problem_framing: 将脑信号解读建模为端到端深度学习问题,需自动发现区分性特征
key_insight: 用强化学习优化选择注意力区域来发现最优维度依赖,绕过手动特征工程
method_signature: Reinforcement Learning Selective Attention + WAS-LSTM Classifier
evaluation_criteria: 准确率/精确率/召回率/F1/AUC/混淆矩阵/延迟
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: RS后的最优顺序无法保证出现,分类结果不理想时需多次尝试;SAM增加了LSTM单元的迭代训练时间
evidence_for_taste: the optimal order can not be guaranteed
the employment of SAM increases the training time
7 subjects limited by the practical conditions
accuracy has an approximately linear relationship with the reward
thinking_moves: 用强化学习把特征选择问题转化为序贯决策优化
将时序信号重排以暴露潜在维度依赖关系
用轮廓系数近似分类精度以降低强化学习奖励模型的训练开销
将eye-closed状态作为确认命令因其在实验中准确率最高
